title: AccountProfile
description: Portfolio account configuration as consumed by AccountAggregatorService (detailed design §51.1).

schema_version.description: Semantic version tag for this schema instance (e.g. accounts.profile.v1).

account_id.description: Unique identifier for the trading account (broker native identifier).

base_currency.description: Primary reporting currency for the account (ISO-4217).

margin_mode.description: Broker specific margin configuration label (e.g. netting, hedged).

max_leverage.description: Maximum leverage configured for the account.

is_hedge.description: Marks hedge-only accounts that offset exposure across the portfolio.

statement_path.description: Filesystem or object storage path template used to import broker statements.

import_schedule_cron.description: Cron expression describing when daily/weekly imports should run.

tags.description: Optional labels used by governance reporting.

notes.description: Free-form operator guidance attached to the account profile.
